topic: Ordering a Get-Well Flower Bouquet for a Friend

script.title: GET-WELL FLOWERS
script.story_hook: A friend is sick, and one bouquet says it all.
script.intro_zh: 朋友生病了，一束花就代表全部心意。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to a cheerful flower shop. Listen for ordering, cards, and delivery.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到一間明亮的花店。請留意訂花、卡片與配送的說法。
script.outro: And that's a get-well gift, all done. Her flowers are already on the road.
script.outro_zh: 探望的禮物就這樣搞定。她那束花已經在路上啦。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a young man in his early twenties with short sandy blond hair swept to one side, a thin gold chain, a slate blue denim jacket over a plain white tee, and a lean build
script.char_b_description: a warm smiling woman in her fifties with silver-gray hair in a loose low ponytail, tiny pearl earrings, a lavender smock over a cream blouse, a petal-stained apron, and a soft round build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need flowers for a sick friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ niːd ˈflaʊɚz fɚ ə sɪk frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我想買束花，送給生病的朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh no, what happened to your friend?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ wʌt həˈpænd tə jɔɹ frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，你朋友怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's home from the hospital, resting now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiːz hoʊm fɹəm ðə ˈhɑspɪɾəl ˈɹɛstɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 她剛從醫院回家，正在休養。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's kind of you. Does she have favorites?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts kaɪnd əv ju dʌz ʃi hæv ˈfeɪvɚɪts/
dialogue.zh: 你有心了。她有沒有特別偏好的花？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, she loves sunflowers, the big bright ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ʃi lʌvz ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚz ðə bɪɡ bɹaɪt wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，她最愛向日葵，那種又大又亮眼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bad news, sunflowers are back next Tuesday.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd nuz ˈsʌnˌflaʊɚz ɑɹ bæk nɛkst ˈtuzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 壞消息，向日葵要到下週二才進貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Aw, that was my entire plan right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔ ðæt wəz maɪ ɛnˈtaɪɚ plæn ɹaɪt ðɛɹ/
dialogue.zh: 唉，我的整個計畫就是它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We could do yellow roses instead, though.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kʊd du ˈjɛloʊ ˈɹoʊzɪz ɪnˈstɛd ðoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不過我們可以用黃玫瑰代替。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yellow roses work, she likes warm colors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjɛloʊ ˈɹoʊzɪz wɝk ʃi laɪks wɔɹm ˈkʌlɚz/
dialogue.zh: 黃玫瑰也不錯，她喜歡暖色調。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, how big should the bouquet be?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ haʊ bɪɡ ʃʊd ðə ˈboʊkeɪ bi/
dialogue.zh: 好，那花束要多大？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something medium, not too loud, you know.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈmidɪəm nɑt tu laʊd ju noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 中等就好，別太招搖，你懂吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Is anyone around her allergic?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt ɪz ˈɛniˌwʌn əˈɹaʊnd hɚ əˈlɝdʒɪk/
dialogue.zh: 了解。她身邊有過敏的人或寵物嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, yes, her cat stays home with her.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl jɛs hɚ kæt ˈsteɪz hoʊm wɪð hɚ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，有的，她家貓咪整天陪著她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing you said, lilies hurt cats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ ju sɛd ˈlɪlɪz hɝt kæts/
dialogue.zh: 還好你有想到，百合會讓貓咪中毒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seriously? I had no clue about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪˈɹɛnli aɪ hæd noʊ kluː əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 真的假的？我完全不知道這件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So, no lilies, and no baby's breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ noʊ ˈlɪlɪz ænd noʊ ˈbeɪbiz bɹɛθ/
dialogue.zh: 所以，不要百合，也不要滿天星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What flowers are safe then? Roses okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈflaʊɚz ɑɹ seɪf ðɛn ˈɹoʊzɪz ˈoʊkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 那哪些花安全？玫瑰應該沒事吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roses, carnations, tulips, all cat-safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊzɪz kɑɹˈneɪʃənz ˈtulɪps ɔl kæt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 玫瑰、康乃馨、鬱金香，對貓都安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tulips, please, mixed with the yellow roses.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtulɪps pliz mɪkst wɪð ðə ˈjɛloʊ ˈɹoʊzɪz/
dialogue.zh: 請給我鬱金香，搭配黃玫瑰。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice combo. Want a vase with that?
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs kɑmˈboʊ wɑnt ə veɪz wɪð ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 這個搭配很棒。要不要附一個花瓶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, does the vase cost extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm dʌz ðə veɪz kɔst ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，花瓶要額外收費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve dollars for a simple glass one.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɛlv ˈdɑɾɚz fɚ ə ˈsɪmpəl ɡlæs wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 簡單款玻璃花瓶要十二塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then yes please, she'll thank me twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn jɛs pliz ʃi θæŋk mi ˈtwaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 那就加吧，她一定會多謝我兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She'll thank you just for showing up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi θæŋk ju dʒʌst fɚ ˈʃoʊɪŋ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 其實她只要看到你，就已經很感謝了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair point. Can I write the card myself?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ pɔɪnt kən aɪ ɹaɪt ðə kɑɹd maɪˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 也對。卡片內容我想自己寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, pens live right on this counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs pɛnz lɪv ɹaɪt ɑn ðɪs ˈkaʊɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 當然，筆就放在這個櫃台上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll start with, Rest now, you stubborn one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl stɑɹt wɪð ɹɛst naʊ ju ˈstʌbɚn wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我要先寫：乖乖休息，固執鬼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! She sounds fun. Anything sillier too?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃi ˈsaʊndz fʌn ˈɛniθɪŋ ˈsɪliɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 哈！光想就知道她很有趣。還要加點更搞笑的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How about, soup can't beat these flowers.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt sup kænt bi ðiːz ˈflaʊɚz/
dialogue.zh: 這句怎麼樣：湯可打不過這束花。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect joke material, I'll write it neatly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt dʒoʊk məˈtɪɹiəl aɪl ɹaɪt ɪt ˈnitli/
dialogue.zh: 完美的笑料，我會工整地替你寫上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do, my handwriting looks like traffic.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz du maɪ ˈhændˌraɪtɪŋ lʊks laɪk ˈtɹæfɪk/
dialogue.zh: 拜託，我的字寫得像車禍現場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's what assistants are famous for.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts wʌt əˈsɪstənts ɑɹ ˈfeɪməs fɚ/
dialogue.zh: 這向來是我們店員的專長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, delivery today, is that still possible?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ dɪˈlɪvɚi təˈdeɪ ɪz ðæt stɪl ˈpɑsəbl/
dialogue.zh: 那今天配送還來得及嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you finish by two, we can try.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju ˈfɪnɪʃ baɪ tu wi kæn tɹaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 兩點前搞定，我們就能試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It's one twenty now, so we're lucky.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts wʌn ˈtwɛnti naʊ soʊ wɪɹ ˈlʌki/
dialogue.zh: 現在一點二十，我們還挺幸運。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where's the drop-off address exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛɹz ðə ˈdɹɑpˌɔf əˈdɹɛs ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 確切要送到哪個地址？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Elm Street, unit nine, right by the park.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛm stiɹt ˈjunɪt naɪn ɹaɪt baɪ ðə pɑɹk/
dialogue.zh: 榆樹街九號單元，就在公園旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, that route is our easiest one.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæt ruːt ɪz ɑɹ ˈiːziəst wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 噢，那條路線是我們最順的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's home all day, resting quietly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiːz hoʊm ɔl deɪ ˈɹɛstɪŋ ˈkwaɪətli/
dialogue.zh: 她整天都待在家裡安靜休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, we'll land between one and four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt wil lænd bɪˈtwin wʌn ænd fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們會在一點到四點之間送到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can your driver text her before knocking?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn jɔɹ ˈdɹaɪvɚ tɛkst hɚ bɪˈfɔɹ ˈnɑkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 送貨前可以先傳簡訊給她嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but we don't have her number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ bʌt wi doʊnt hæv hɚ ˈnʌmbɚ/
dialogue.zh: 可以，不過我們沒有她的電話號碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll text her your number right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl tɛkst hɚ jɔɹ ˈnʌmbɚ ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在就把你的號碼傳給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And if nobody answers the doorbell?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf ˈnoʊˌbɑdi ˈænsɚz ðə ˈdɔɹˌbɛl/
dialogue.zh: 要是按了電鈴沒人開呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then leave it with the front desk, um, safe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɪv ɪt wɪð ðə ˈfɹʌnt dɛsk ʌm ˈseɪf/
dialogue.zh: 那就交給櫃台，嗯，會安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Front desk signs for us, totally fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹʌnt dɛsk saɪnz fɚ ʌs ˈtɑɾli faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 櫃台會幫我們代簽，完全沒問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. So what's the total with everything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt soʊ wʌts ðə ˈtoʊɾəl wɪð ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。這樣總共多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty-six, with vase and delivery included.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔɹti sɪks wɪð veɪz ænd dɪˈlɪvɚi ɪnˈkludɪd/
dialogue.zh: 四十六塊，含花瓶和運費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's fair, honestly. Can I pay by card?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts fɛɹ ˈɑnəstli kən aɪ peɪ baɪ kɑɹd/
dialogue.zh: 老實講很划算。可以刷卡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap or insert, whichever you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tæp ɔɹ ɪnˈsɚt wɪtˈɛvɚ ju laɪk/
dialogue.zh: 可以，感應或插卡都歡迎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap, um, hold on, did it go through?
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ʌm ˈhoʊld ɑn dɪd ɪt ˈɡoʊ θɹu/
dialogue.zh: 感應，嗯，稍等，這筆進去了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It did, want the receipt emailed too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dɪd wɑnt ðə ɹɪˈsit ˈimeɪld tu/
dialogue.zh: 成功了。收據也要用郵件傳給你嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please, paper receipts vanish from my table.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz ˈpeɪpɚ ˈɹɪsits ˈvænɪʃ fɹəm maɪ ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，紙本收據在我桌上總是不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood. Your flowers leave within twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd jɔɹ ˈflaʊɚz liv wɪˈðɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 知道了。你的花二十分鐘內就會出發。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're saving my friendship today, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹz ˈseɪvɪŋ maɪ ˈfɹɛndʃɪp təˈdeɪ ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 老實講，你今天救回了我這段友情。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, flowers fix almost everything in this shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈflaʊɚz fɪks ˈɔlmoʊst ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ ɪn ðɪs ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 哈，在我們店裡，花幾乎能修好一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She's going to love this, I'm sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃiːz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə lʌv ðɪs aɪm ʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 她一定會愛上這束花的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wish her a fast recovery from us.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪʃ hɚ ə fæst ɹɪˈkʌvɚi fɹəm ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 我們也祝她早日康復。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you again, you've been so kind.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju əˈɡɛn juv bɪn soʊ kaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 再一次謝謝你，你真的很體貼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye now, the courier's almost out the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ naʊ ðə ˈkʊɹɪɚz ˈɔlmoʊst aʊt ðə dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 再見，送貨員快出門了。

script.youtube_title: 【探望生病的朋友💐】「你今天救回了我這段友情」從選花到送貨💐🌷🚚💳｜聽完就能自己訂花｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Get-Well Flowers
script.youtube_title_en: "You're Saving My Friendship Today" — Ordering Get-Well Flowers with Same-Day Delivery
script.youtube_description:
「你今天救回了我這段友情」——去探望生病的朋友，怎麼在花店挑一束對貓咪安全的花、把卡片寫好、再趕在當天送到？這是一支 60 句的沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在一間溫暖的花店櫃台前。

你會聽到：跟店員開場並說明來意；向日葵剛好缺貨的小打擊；因為貓咪而避開百合的安全選花；卡片內容怎麼下筆、請店員代筆；當日配送的截止時間、地址確認、沒人在家時的代簽收；還有總價、刷卡與收據。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與十個詞以內的短句，重現美國人走進花店的真實語感：um、well、so、ha、fair point。聽完你就會用：I need flowers for...、Is that still possible?、Can I pay by card?、What's the total with everything?。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"You're saving my friendship today" — sometimes the best medicine is a bouquet delivered before dinner. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a warm little flower shop counter.

You will hear: explaining why you need flowers, the small blow of sold-out sunflowers, picking cat-safe blooms after a lily warning, drafting (and delegating!) the card message, and locking down same-day delivery, drop-off backup, price, and payment.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, ha, fair point. By the end you'll own phrases like I need flowers for..., Is that still possible?, and Can I pay by card?

The back half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧花店訂花英文｜缺貨換花・對貓安全選花・當日送貨｜探望朋友這一束剛好｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
朋友剛從醫院回家修養，你想送一束花，卻不知道哪種花對家有貓咪的人不安全？卡片上那句話該怎麼寫才顯得真心？當天還來得及送到嗎？

這一集帶大家走進一間溫暖的花店，從說明來意、替換缺貨的向日葵、避開對貓危險的百合，一路聽到卡片代筆、當日配送、櫃台代收與結帳，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
💐 點明需求：I need flowers for a sick friend.
🌷 安全選花：What flowers are safe then? Roses okay?
✉️ 卡片金句：How about, soup can't beat these flowers.
🚚 當日配送：So, delivery today, is that still possible?

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這趟買花之旅走一趟，下次你想替人帶份心意，話自己就會出口。

祝你身邊的人早日康復。
